ENH: return GeoSeries when accessing other (non "active") geometry columns
Now that that we have the geometry dtype and ExtensionArray based GeometryArray, it is more transparent to have multiple geometry columns (which was already possible before, but they were all "object")

```
In [30]: df = geopandas.read_file(geopandas.datasets.get_path('naturalearth_lowres')) 

In [31]: df['centroids'] = df.geometry.centroid   

In [32]: df.dtypes   
Out[32]: 
pop_est          int64
continent       object
name            object
iso_a3          object
gdp_md_est     float64
geometry      geometry
centroids     geometry
dtype: object
```

But, when accessing the column, we only box it into a GeoSeries if it was the "active" geometry column, and not for other "geometry"-dtype columns:

```
In [33]: type(df['geometry']) 
Out[33]: geopandas.geoseries.GeoSeries

In [34]: type(df['centroids'])  
Out[34]: pandas.core.series.Series
```

Now that we can check the dtype of the column for GeometryDtype, we can actually also return a GeoSeries for other geometry columns, enabling the same functionality (additional functions provided by the GeoSeries subclass) for those columns. 
(the GeoDataFrame level functions of course keep using the "active" geometry column, just as it is the case now)

Let's first start by reproducing the results of the issue. The issue includes some example code for reproduction, which we can use. We'll create a new file called `reproduce.py` and paste the example code into it.
